LESSON: READING 5.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading, part of Strand 5 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read a variety of materials? 2. How do you identify the book you want to read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. preview a text by focusing on the title, author, among others (fiction/ non-fiction) 1251- 1500 words),

2. collaborate to determine the appropriateness of a reading text,

3. skim texts on the theme of tourist attraction sites in Kenya to find out the general idea,

4. scan a text to find specific details such as key words,

5. select and read an appropriate reading material based on their interest. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. preview a text by focusing on the title, author, among others (fiction/ non-fiction) 1251- 1500 words),
2. collaborate to determine the appropriateness of a reading text,
3. skim texts on the theme of tourist attraction sites in Kenya to find out the general idea,
4. scan a text to find specific details such as key words,
5. select and read an appropriate reading material based on their interest. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: The learner’s ability to grasp information is enhanced as they interact with a variety of texts.

• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: The learner’s ability to solve simple problems is developed through

selection and reading of appropriate texts based on their interest.

42

Values:
Responsibility: This is cultivated in the learner as they undertake assigned roles when selecting and reading an

appropriate reading material based on their interest.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

Patriotism: This is advocated for as the learner is exposed to information on our tourist attraction sites by reading

texts on the said theme.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The skill of extensive reading is appropriate in the learning and study of Agriculture.
